en.name: Pumpkin seeds, roasted, in the shell
en.summary: Roasted pumpkin seeds still in the shell keep 6 months in a cool, dry cupboard. The hull protects the kernel from air and the roasting has already driven out the moisture, so this is an ordinary pantry snack with no refrigeration figure attached.
en.pantry: 6 months in an airtight container, cool, dark and dry. Two things are working in your favour here: the fibrous hull keeps most of the oxygen off the kernel, and roasting has left the seed very dry. Nothing grows in them, so the limit is flavour — the oil in the kernel oxidises slowly and eventually tastes bitter instead of sweet and toasted. If they are salted, the salt will draw moisture out of a humid room, so the container needs to seal properly or the shells go soft and chewy.
en.fridge: Roasted in-shell pumpkin seeds do not need the fridge. The hull is already the barrier, and a sealed jar in a cool cupboard gets you the whole cupboard window without using fridge space. In a persistently hot, humid kitchen a properly airtight jar in the fridge does no harm; let it warm up before opening so condensation does not settle on the hulls.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published either. Freezing does not damage roasted seeds, but there is little to gain over an airtight jar when the cupboard already gives half a year. If you have roasted a big batch, let it cool completely before sealing — steam trapped in a warm jar softens the shells faster than anything on this page.
en.thawing: Nothing to thaw. Let a chilled container reach room temperature before you open it.
spoilage: A bitter or fishy taste in the kernel once you crack the shell.
Shells that have gone soft and chewy instead of splitting crisply.
A smell of old cooking oil rather than roasted nuttiness.
Mould, a musty smell, or insects in a jar that got damp.
tips: Cool home-roasted seeds completely before putting the lid on.
Salted seeds need a better seal than unsalted ones; salt pulls in moisture.
Crisp softened seeds briefly in a low oven and cool them fully before storing again.
Crack a few from different parts of the jar before serving a bowl.

faq.q: How long do roasted in-shell pumpkin seeds keep?
faq.a: 6 months in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark cupboard.

faq.q: Do roasted pumpkin seeds in the shell need refrigerating?
faq.a: No refrigerated timeline is published and none is needed. The hull keeps air off the kernel, so a sealed jar in a cupboard is enough.

faq.q: Why have my roasted pumpkin seeds gone soft?
faq.a: They have taken up moisture, usually from a humid kitchen or from being sealed while still warm. A few minutes in a low oven and a full cool-down fixes it.

zh.name: 烤帶殼南瓜籽
zh.summary: 還帶殼的烤南瓜籽，放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃可放 6 個月。殼把空氣擋在種仁外，烘烤又早已把水分趕走，所以它就是一般的櫥櫃零食，沒有附帶冷藏的數字。
zh.pantry: 氣密容器、陰涼、避光、乾燥，6 個月。這裡有兩件事站在你這邊：帶纖維的殼把大部分氧氣擋在種仁外，而烘烤又讓種子非常乾。裡面長不出東西，所以限制在於風味——種仁的油脂慢慢氧化，最後會從香甜變成發苦。如果是加鹽的，鹽會把潮濕房間裡的水吸過來，容器就必須真的密得住，否則殼會變軟變韌。
zh.fridge: 烤帶殼南瓜籽不需要冷藏。殼本身就是屏障，密封罐放陰涼櫥櫃就能走完整段常溫期限，不必占冰箱位子。如果廚房長期又熱又濕，用真正氣密的罐子冷藏也無妨；拿出來請先回溫再開，免得結露落在殼上。
zh.freezer: 冷凍同樣沒有期限數據。冷凍不會傷到烤過的種子，但既然櫥櫃已經給了半年，它比氣密罐多不了什麼。自己烤了一大盤的話，請完全放涼再密封——溫熱時封起來困住的蒸氣，會比這一頁上任何東西都更快把殼弄軟。
zh.thawing: 沒有東西要解凍。冰過的容器請回到室溫再打開。
spoilage: 剝開殼後，種仁嚐起來發苦或帶腥味。
殼變軟變韌，不再脆脆地裂開。
聞起來像久放的食用油，而不是烘烤的香氣。
受潮的罐子長霉、有霉味或生蟲。
tips: 自家烤的要完全放涼才蓋蓋子。
加鹽的比無鹽的更需要密封，鹽會把水氣吸進來。
軟掉的用低溫烤箱烘一下，完全放涼後再收。
整盤端出去前，先從罐子不同位置剝幾顆確認。

faq.q: 烤帶殼南瓜籽可以放多久？
faq.a: 氣密容器放陰涼、乾燥、避光的櫥櫃，6 個月。

faq.q: 烤帶殼南瓜籽需要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 沒有公布冷藏期限，也不需要。殼把空氣擋在種仁外，密封罐放櫥櫃就夠了。

faq.q: 烤南瓜籽為什麼變軟了？
faq.a: 它吸了水氣，通常來自濕熱的廚房，或是沒放涼就密封。低溫烤箱烘幾分鐘、完全放涼再收就好。
